title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
summary: The agreement will allow the two state regulators to share supervisory information, streamline licensing reviews and coordinate examinations and enforcement actions involving digital asset firms.

title: Bitcoin fights for local uptrend as US bond yields drop from new 24-year highs
summary: US bond yields fell sharply around Thursday’s Wall Street open as Bitcoin price action sought to preserve a local trend of higher lows.

title: Stocks Bounce From Lows as Treasury Selloff Eases: Markets Wrap
summary: A selloff in Treasuries eased after yields hit multi-decade highs, with stocks rebounding from Thursday’s lows in a session marked by concerns over inflationary pressures stemming from elevated oil prices.

title: Treasuries Rebound, Pulling 10-Year Yield Back From 24-Year High
summary: US Treasuries rebounded from the global bond selloff that raced through European markets on Thursday, pulling 10-year yields back from a 24-year high.
